claims.text: The authors proposed two new unsupervised representation-learning objectives: FastSent and Sequential Denoising Autoencoders.
FastSent performs particularly well on the MSRP task, while Sequential Denoising Autoencoders excel on the SICK sentence relatedness task.
If the application is unknown, DictRep is suggested as a good all-round choice for learning representations.
